entry.title: New: RES26-279 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT VALUED AT $1,728.07 TO THE CITY FROM THE OKINAWA LIFESAVING ASSOCIATION FOR THE HONOLULU OCEAN SAFETY DEPARTMART CHIEF TO TRAVEL TO OKINAWA, JAPAN, TO PARTICIPATE IN OFFICIAL OCEAN SAFETY EXCHANGE AND PARTNERSHIP ACTIVITIES FROM OCTOBER 12-16, 2026.

Latest action: Introduced.
